name: nginx-multisite
description: Provides an Nginx multi-site web server for three virtual hosts, including HTTPS, static content, firewall rules, Fail2ban, SSH restrictions, and sysctl hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, logging, runtime directories, service enablement, and configuration cleanup.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI tutorial application with Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, a virtual environment, application configuration, database provisioning, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
